Each Cercle de lien is a ring of standing stones; the key sits on the stone at its heart. The eastern circle is on the hills north-west of Hammerfall. Careful: Each center stone is guarded by around three elementals near level 39 that attack together if you click the stone without clearing them: Burning Exiles at West, Thundering Exiles at Outer, Cresting Exiles at East.
Récupérez 1 × Clé armoriée (Pierre de Lien orientale)

The Witherbark trolls hold the village in the south-eastern hills. Axe Throwers guard the outer huts; the Witch Doctors and Headhunters hold the heart of the village. Careful: All three troll types flee for help at 15% health, which can pull more trolls from the nearby camps.
